interpretation: Widening the nuisance bounds does not identify the survival response; five populations run to the new lower bound. Additional unconstrained nuisance freedom would absorb selection mismatch into density and is scientifically unsafe.
resolved: The source of the conservative-gate failure is identified as selection-response non-identifiability, not optimizer failure.
required_external_input: Population-matched survival/bias calibration or a CAMELS-like mock with CF4 luminosity/ARES selection applied and independently validated.
